purpose: Numerical check of the sub-cycle peak with a fixed fine step set through the native ANDES TDS configuration (time_step_s = dt/16 over the whole run, no local refinement, tf = 20 s instead of 200 s); same equilibrium targets, dispatches and controller B5'; the historical executor uses dt = 2^-8 with a local dt/16 on [t_e - dt, t_e + 0.5 s].

hypotheses.N1: The minimum Pmax margin in 0-50 ms of each run differs from the historical value by <= 0.0005 pu (the dt/2, dt/4 tests moved it by <= 1.3e-4 pu), with the same limiting unit and the peak instant within one local step (0.24 ms).
hypotheses.N2: The class of A at b21 S3 (historical -0.01097, 7e-5 pu beyond the band U_D8) may change with the step: this run decides whether the UNSAFE class is robust; the physical violation (m < 0) is expected to persist whatever the step.
hypotheses.N3: Differences in the event synchronisation (the event is applied at t_e = 5 s on the step grid; with a fixed step dt/16 the event falls on a grid point in both cases) are documented, not corrected.

decision_rule: |margin_fixed - margin_historical| <= 0.0005 pu confirms step insensitivity; larger changes are reported as a limitation of the historical executor and the affected classifications are downgraded.
